definitions.short: Arjok , the name of two Babylonians
definitions.full: H746. Aryowk אַרְיוֺךְ proper name, masculine king of Ellasar Gen 14:1 , 9 , ally of Chedorlaomer in his western foray (probably = Rim-Aku , Elamite king of Larsa = Ellasar; compare COT ii. 297 f. ). **On Rim-Akw (= Eri-Aku ?), see now also Dr Comm. Gn. 156 ff. ; Zim KAT 3. 367 thinks identification very dubious. אֲרִיסַי proper name, masculine son of Haman Est 9:9 ; Αρσαιος .
